parts.name: bed_plate
parts.desc: MIC-6 bed plate, 240 x 240 x 6.35 mm: it floats 17 mm above the deck on three M4 studs (countersunk screws from its top face, each locked to it by a nut underneath), pushed up by three die springs against three thumb nuts under the deck; the heater pad is bonded under it, the magnetic base on top.

findings.message: bed_plate: 3 countersink(s): a second operation after cutting (model plain through holes in the cut file).
findings.hint: Use button- or cap-head screws on a plain hole, or thicker stock.

findings.message: bed_plate: 3 hole(s) or cut-out(s) narrower than the 6.35 mm sheet (smallest 3.80 mm at [-128.15, -35.5, 188.53]): they cut, but taper and lose accuracy.
findings.hint: Make them at least 6.35 mm, or drill or ream them after cutting if the size matters.

findings.message: bed_plate: 6 hole(s) with less than 6.35 mm of material to the edge (least 3.52 mm at [-86.0, -107.5, 188.53]): the web overheats and distorts, and tears if the part is bent or loaded.
findings.hint: Move the hole in, or widen the part there, to leave at least 6.35 mm.

findings.message: bed_plate (al_mic6, 6.35 mm, flat): assigned SendCutSend: passes. Passes the published rules of: Fictiv, Hubs (Protolabs Network), OSH Cut, Protolabs, SendCutSend, Xometry.

parts.name: bed_spring_2
parts.desc: Bed levelling point 2: an M4 x 60 countersunk screw from the bed's top face (head 0.7 mm below it, under the magnetic base) is locked to the plate by a washer and nut underneath, so it is a fixed stud. A die spring (DJ-8X20YCS, 7.6 N/mm, compressed 8 mm: 61 N) between that nut and the deck pushes the bed up; the stud passes the deck through a 5.5 mm oversize hole (rear: free) and a large washer and knurled thumb nut under the deck hold it down (the nut on two 10 mm spacers, below the 2020 square, where fingers reach it). Turn the thumb nut to level: 0.7 mm per turn, +/-1.5 mm. Three points: they set the bed's plane and cannot twist the plate.
parts.model_source: Century Spring's supplier STEP of DJ-8X20YCS (supplier batch 2026-11-18), drawn at its 20 mm free length; shown compressed to the installed height along its axis (display only)

parts.name: z_deck
parts.desc: Deck: 3.175 mm (1/8 in) 6061 sheet on top of the 2020 square, twelve M5 into T-nuts. It closes the rectangle in shear, shields the carrier from the heater, and is what the bed is levelled against: the three bed studs pass through it (one fitted hole, one slot, one oversize) and the thumb nuts bear on its underside.
